messages.en:
{07 0b 00}Say, have you been{01 00 00 05 00}
collecting furniture?

{07 14 00}Well, if there's anything
you don't need, just send
it to me, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Ütle, kas sa oled{01 00 00 05 00}
mööblit kogunud?

{07 14 00}Noh, kui sul on midagi,
mida sa ei vaja, saada
see mulle, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}As soon as I bought my
furniture, I just started
lining those bad boys up!
{07 06 00}But before I knew it, all my
chairs ended up in back and
{01 00 00 05 00}now I can't sit down!
{07 15 00}Learn from my terrible
tale! {01 00 00 05 00}Be more careful than
me when you decorate!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kohe kui ma oma mööbli
ostsin, hakkasin neid
lahedaid asju ritta seadma!
{07 06 00}Aga enne kui arugi sain,
olid kõik toolid taga ja
{01 00 00 05 00}nüüd ei saa ma istuda!
{07 15 00}Õpi minu kohutavast
loost! {01 00 00 05 00}Ole kaunistades
ettevaatlikum kui mina!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Yeah, there was a ton of
furniture that I wanted...

{07 16 00}But before I buy anything,{01 00 00 05 00}
I gotta do something about
my sweaty floors!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Jah, ma tahtsin tonni
mööblit...

{07 16 00}Aga enne kui midagi ostan,{01 00 00 05 00}
pean ma midagi ette võtma
oma higiste põrandatega!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Man, I've been{01 00 00 05 00} so pumped up
about rearranging my
furniture lately!
Thing is, I need to peep
into other people's rooms
for reference...
{07 11 00}So next time you're not
home, I'm gonna stop by
your pad, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Mees, ma olen{01 00 00 05 00} viimasel ajal
nii hoos mööbli
ümberpaigutamisest!
Asi on selles, et ma pean
teiste inimeste tubadesse
piiluma, et eeskuju saada...
{07 11 00}Nii et järgmine kord, kui sa
kodus pole, astun ma
sinu juurest läbi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Doing sit-ups makes me
tear my old clothes...

I'm running low on my
Super Bod Ultra-Buffing
Protein Powder...
{07 0f 00}I don't have the luxury
to buy new furniture,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Kõhulihaste tegemine rebib
mu vanad riided katki...

Mul hakkab otsa saama
Super Keha Ultra-Krussi
Proteiinipulber...
{07 0f 00}Mul pole luksust uut
mööblit osta,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Yo, {ff 00 00 05}{04 1f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Are you collecting
furniture, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 04 00}Who, me!{01 00 00 0f 00} Nah!{01 00 00 05 00} Not this dude!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}I'm not that into it, know
what I mean, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}For right now,{01 00 00 05 00} priority one
is getting an Ultrasweat
4000 Exercise Lounge!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Jou, {ff 00 00 05}{04 1f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Kas sa kogud
mööblit, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 04 00}Kes, mina!{01 00 00 0f 00} Ei!{01 00 00 05 00} Mina mitte!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}Mind see eriti ei huvita,
saad aru, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}Praegu on{01 00 00 05 00} peamine eesmärk
saada Ultrahigi 4000
trenni-lamamistool!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I wanted my place to look 
different, so I mulled some
options over, but...
{07 14 00}It's a lost cause.{01 00 00 05 00} I just
can't bring myself to care!{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 03 00}War har har har!!!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma tahtsin, et mu koht 
näeks teistsugune välja, nii
et mõtlesin, aga...
{07 14 00}See on lootusetu.{01 00 00 05 00} Ma ei
suuda lihtsalt hoolida!{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 03 00}Vaar haar haar!!!
